title: AstroML VariableStarClassification

stats.done_summary: Completed the AstroML Variable Star Classification research task. Implemented multiple feature engineering approaches (frequency-based, positional, time-series/SAX interpretation) and evaluated various ML models (Random Forest, SVM, Gradient Boosting, etc.). The best model (SVM with RBF kernel) achieved 0.579 validation balanced accuracy and 0.533 test balanced accuracy. Generated comprehensive visualizations and produced a detailed research report with methodology, results, and discussion sections.
